|
|-- workspace: CanvasWorkspace                 owns session lifetimes

|   |   |-- baseline: savedName / savedScene / savedEdges?
|   |   |-- viewport? / focusBox? / newerRevision?
|   |   `-- session: CanvasSession
|   |       |-- controller: MappingDocumentController    domain-state owner
|   |       |   |-- context: CanvasEditingContext       history-service handle
|   |       |   |-- getSnapshot(): ControllerSnapshot
|   |       |   |   |-- contextId / canvasRevisionId / version
|   |       |   |   |-- canUndo / canRedo / cell? / endpointBounds?
|   |       |   |   |-- document: MappingGridDocument
|   |       |   |   |   |-- scene: LineGridScene
|   |       |   |   |   |   |-- root: GridBox            recursive placement
|   |       |   |   |   |   |   |-- id / position / minimumSize? / collapsed
|   |       |   |   |   |   |   |-- collapsedContentId? -> contents
|   |       |   |   |   |   |   |-- diagram: contentId -> contents
|   |       |   |   |   |   |   `-- container: children[] / push-right / gap
|   |       |   |   |   |   `-- contents[contentId]: Diagram
|   |       |   |   |   |       |-- diagramId / revisionId / id / revision
|   |       |   |   |   |       |-- content: DiagramContent
|   |       |   |   |   |       |   |-- revisionId / ascii / asciiSha256
|   |       |   |   |   |       |   `-- structure
|   |       |   |   |   |       |       |-- diagram
|   |       |   |   |   |       |       `-- tree: parserVersion / rootIds
|   |       |   |   |   |       |           `-- nodes: links / spans / folds
|   |       |   |   |   |       |-- sourceContext: binding? / contentHash
|   |       |   |   |   |       |   `-- mappings[] -> evidence / sourceRanges
|   |       |   |   |   |       `-- jumps?
|   |       |   |   |   `-- edges[] / sections / jumps?
|   |       |   |   `-- canvas: MappingCanvasState
|   |       |   |       |-- selection.items[]: SelectionItem
|   |       |   |       |   |-- id / displayNodeId
|   |       |   |       |   |-- no region: whole diagram instance
|   |       |   |       |   `-- region: captured ASCII / rect / selectedIds
|   |       |   |       |       `-- sourceContentId / sourceRevisionId?
|   |       |   |       |-- diagramViews?: per-instance content folding
|   |       |   |       |-- display: DisplayState       floating ownership tree
|   |       |   |       |   |-- rootIds[] / nodes[id]: FloatingPane
|   |       |   |       |   |-- common: childIds / expansion / geometryPolicy
|   |       |   |       |   |   `-- position / bounds / canvas|viewport space
|   |       |   |       |   |-- selection: captured region / child display mode
|   |       |   |       |   |-- projection: title / content
|   |       |   |       |   |   `-- call-tree | compaction | source-code
|   |       |   |       |   |       `-- or code-panel
|   |       |   |       |   |-- conversation: thread / draft / canvasAnchor
|   |       |   |       |   |   `-- presentation: compact | floating | docked
|   |       |   |       |   `-- detail: title / ascii / sectionId?
|   |       |   |       `-- controls: activeBoxId / selectionFocusId
|   |       |   |           `-- activeThreadId / surfaces[id]: prompt + ask UI
|   |       |   |-- nodes(): CanvasDisplayNode[]        derived read-only registry
|   |       |   |   |-- common: id / version / childIds / expansion / collapsible
|   |       |   |   |-- grid: diagram | group           geometry in cells
|   |       |   |   |   `-- boxId / content? / contentNodes? / diagram?
|   |       |   |   `-- floating: pane variants | arrow  geometry in pixels
|   |       |   |       |-- placement / value
|   |       |   |       `-- arrows derived from document.edges
|   |       |   `-- applyUpdate(expectedVersion, operations)
|   |       |       |-- stage edits -> validate -> append history -> publish
|   |       |       `-- returns { version, nodes }; transact uses the same path
|   |       `-- readable stores                        immutable controller views
|   |           |-- document / presentation / selection / controls / geometry
|   |           `-- status: isDirty / sceneDirty / canUndo / canRedo
|   |-- controllers[documentId]                        references session controllers
|   |-- changes.version / dirtyScenes.ids              derived workspace signals
|   `-- setDrafts / copyDocument / dispose             create, fork, release sessions
|
|-- viewState: SourcePaneViewState                      live scroll + camera owner

|-- activeId / mountedDocuments / transfers[] / pendingTransfer
|-- rendering: DraggableDiagramCanvas -> MappingPocSelectionCanvas(session)
|   `-- camera changes -> viewState; edits -> session.controller
|-- agent commands                                    use workspace/controller paths
|   |-- context -> { version, name, nodes, edges }

|
|-- persistence: WorkspacePersistence                  translates owners into records
|   |-- workspace.onPersist(ids) -> sync(ids)
|   |   `-- controller.persistenceChanges(cursor) + metadata + baseline + view
|   `-- viewState.subscribe(id) -> syncView(id) -> canvas / viewport records
|-- storage: WorkspaceStorage                          supplied or page-created
|   |-- records: RecordStorage                         cache / pending / in-flight batch
|   |   `-- batch -> flush -> transport.write -> acknowledged revision
|   `-- worker                                         one per opened workspace
|

    |-- schemaVersion: 3 / projectId / activeDocumentId? / transfers[]
    `-- documents[]: MappingDocumentSnapshot
        |-- representationId / savedRepresentationId? / name / revisionId / hidden?
        |-- savedName / savedScene / savedEdges? / history
        `-- document / canvas with captured scroll / captured viewport?
            `-- transfer publication: storage.save(snapshot) -> installWorkspace
